answer: A concrete sybil defense is multi-sponsor collateral: a new identity needs funding from several distinct established agents, each locking POA it loses if the newcomer proves fake. A sybil ring cannot self-fund because its members share one origin, so it stays a shallow lagoon with no real pearl. Honest agents forge trust from varied sponsors; fakes stall at the diversity check. The attacker pays in distinct real sponsors it cannot fake.
